text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard aegis-5b-v1 into the model catalog tomorrow 10:30 PT. Canary window 30m. Need owners for smoke checks + rollback readiness. @ben @maria can you take this?
ben: I can own the canary and pin steps. I'll be on from 10:15 PT. What's the smoke checklist?
maria: I can run the eval set and validate outputs/latency. Share the slot and pin details.
sarah: slot: catalog-slot-17 (staging -> canary). Please pin to aegis-5b:v1 and set "no-auto-swap" for the window. Also disable autoscale burst for 30m to keep metrics stable.
kai: Adding a short smoke checklist — copy/paste friendly:
```
1) Send 10 canonical prompts via staging API: POST /v1/generate (use smoke key)
2) Tail model pods: kubectl -n catalog logs -l model=aegis-5b --since=5m
3) Check metrics: p95 latency < 220ms, error-rate < 1%, token-cost within expected range
4) Run eval: python tools/eval.py --suite chat-smoke-2026-03 --model aegis-5b:v1
```
ben: Got it. Rollback command if we need to revert quickly: 
```
# revert catalog pin and promote previous alias
redwood catalog rollback --model aegis-5b --to-alias previous-stable --confirm
```
maria: Note: this variant is quantized int4, so watch tokenization edge cases (rare truncation on long prompts). I'll run the eval set right after canary opens and post a diff (ETA ~15m).
sarah: @ben please set the model pin in the catalog config and open the canary slot at 10:30 PT. I'll update the runbook with the checklist and call the go/no-go at 10:05 PT.
ben: on it. PR for pin: https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/1293 — adding config change and no-auto-swap flag.
maria: Creating eval ticket and will post results to this thread.
kai: I've added the canary block to the team calendar and wired alerts: eng-oncall pager if error-rate > 1% or latency > 500ms. Also created a lightweight dashboard for p50/p95/ephemeral errors.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for 2026-03-15T17:30:00Z (10:30 PT). Canary 30m. Change ID cr-9876.
ben: Preflight smoke (10:18 PT): sample responses look correct, no obvious tokenization drops in small batch. Ready to open traffic.
maria: Eval results posted: pass 98/100 checks; two minor hallucination cases flagged (ticket #3456). Not blocking for canary, will monitor.
sarah: Decision: proceed with canary. @ben open traffic at 10:30. If anything regresses, rollback within first 10m.
ben: Traffic opened. Monitoring logs and metrics now.
kai: Alerts quiet so far. p95 ~180ms, error-rate 0.1%.
maria: Outputs consistent with expected distribution. Marking smoke as PASS for the initial window.
sarah: Nice work — leaving canary open for the remaining 10m for broader sampling. Thanks everyone :tada:
deploy-bot: canary complete. Promoted to staging alias after 30m. Audit: cr-9876 promoted by ben.
sarah: I'll schedule the formal catalog release next week and follow up with release notes. Closing this thread — re-open if any regressions appear.
